response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with a strong track record in web, backend, and open-source work, but the profile does not match the core requirements of this role. The position demands 8 years of C++ programming; the resume shows roughly six months of professional C/C++ work at National Instruments (2014–2015) plus a university thesis project, with no C++ in the skills list. Large-scale infrastructure exposure is limited to the Dunnhumby/Sociomantic low-latency D-lang services and self-hosted Kubernetes deployments, and there is no evidence of production cloud compute platform architecture or a formal technical leadership/mentoring role owning cross-team strategy and delivery. Strong mentoring signals exist via workshops and courses, but they do not substitute for the missing C++ and platform-scale leadership depth.
strengths: Deep, broad polyglot engineering experience across backend, embedded, and distributed low-latency systems
Demonstrated knowledge-sharing and mentoring via workshops, courses, and conference talks
Strong software craftsmanship background: TDD, CI/CD, open-source test tooling, DevOps setup
concerns: Far short of the 8 years C++ requirement (~6 months professional C/C++)
No evidence of formal technical leadership role or owning cross-team technical strategy
Limited large-scale cloud compute platform / production cloud architecture experience
